focus_area_title: Understand What Your Team Has Shared
content_text_body:
* Block 30 minutes on your own calendar to review the results. Here is a [quick guide](https://community.glintinc.com/docs/DOC-1174) to walk you through how to interpret the data.

* Here are some Do's and Don'ts when reviewing your team's data:

> * Do use the reports to identify the focus areas that are most engaging/important for your team and are most actionable at your level. These results are likely to surface some suggestions you cannot influence. Remind your team that central groups are also reviewing these insights for feedback they can influence, but in order to help our people most, we must take action at all levels.  What are the highest priority areas you and your team can influence?

> * Do look at people's verbatim comments (if available), not only the numerical results

> * Do take time to understand the data without rushing to action

> * Do think about what team members have said and try to imagine how it feels from their perspective

> * Don't try to guess individual responses or comments

> * Don't take this personally; this is an opportunity for you to drive meaningful conversations with your team and drive improvements together

* Form your own interpretation of the data - What things do your team think are going well right now? What are their main areas for concern?

*If your survey includes an Engagement or eSat scoreâ€¦*

* What experiences (positive or negative) are having the biggest impact on their engagement?  The 'Driver Impact Report' will provide this information.

> Note: If you have a smaller team, here are some additional [suggestions](https://community.glintinc.com/docs/DOC-1411) to consider for how best to involve your team in the results feedback and action planning steps.
